# Quacktory Catalog

> 124 universal design prompts for any demo site — palette, typography, hero pattern, and motion grammar that can be reused across any topic. Browse, copy a prompt, open the live demo.

## Catalog

- URL: https://ssm82.github.io/quacktory-catalog/
- Entries: 154
- Demo sites: https://ssm82.github.io/quacktory-catalog/sites/<slug>/
- Full prompt dump: https://ssm82.github.io/quacktory-catalog/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://ssm82.github.io/quacktory-catalog/sitemap.xml

Each entry is a universal style/design prompt that can be pasted into a 
fresh project in any topic (coffee shop, law firm, science museum) and 
still produce a site that feels structurally and aesthetically identical 
to the original.
